command: set -u; OUT="$HOME/Downloads/BlueEye-HCI"; mkdir -p "$OUT"; rm -f "$OUT/btsnoop_hci.log"; for p in /data/misc/bluetooth/logs/btsnoop_hci.log /data/misc/bluedroid/btsnoop_hci.log /data/log/bt/btsnoop_hci.log /sdcard/btsnoop_hci.log; do echo TRY=$p; if adb pull "$p" "$OUT/btsnoop_hci.log" >/tmp/blueeye-hci-pull.txt 2>&1; then echo PULLED_FROM=$p; break; else tail -n 2 /tmp/blueeye-hci-pull.txt; fi; done; if [ -s "$OUT/btsnoop_hci.log" ]; then echo HCI_DIRECT_PULL_PASS; echo LOCAL_PATH="$OUT/btsnoop_hci.log"; wc -c "$OUT/btsnoop_hci.log"; shasum -a 256 "$OUT/btsnoop_hci.log"; file "$OUT/btsnoop_hci.log"; else echo HCI_DIRECT_PULL_FAILED; exit 45; fi
